name: axio360
description: Connect Claude to Axio360 for cyber risk assessments, scenario analysis, creates/updates, and stakeholder reporting.

api_token.title: API Token
api_token.description: Your Axio360 API token. Find it in Axio360 under Account Settings → API Access.

environment.title: Region
environment.description: Your Axio360 region: us (default), ca, or eu. Leave blank for US. Not case-sensitive.

tools.description: Report which Axio360 region this connection targets

tools.description: Return the currently authenticated user

tools.description: Get scores for an assessment

tools.name: list_assessment_models
